messages.content:
Risk: Dangerous Content
Description: Content that may cause harm to oneself and/or others, including instructions for violence, self-harm, or dangerous activities
Concern: None
Policy: Mental Health & Therapeutic Communication

Candidate ontology classes:
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DangerousInformation: Dangerous Information — Knowledge or instructions that enable serious physical harm, weapons production, or dangerous activities when acquired or executed by untrained individuals outside regulated contexts. [found by 4/4 queries]
  Siblings: Sexual Content, Intellectual Property, Hate and Discrimination
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#ThreatsOfViolence: Threats of Violence — Communication of intent to inflict harm or damage to create fear, even if not carried out. [found by 3/4 queries]
  Siblings: Homicide, Glorification of Violence, Weapons Use
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#HarmfulHowTo: Harmful How-To — Step-by-step instructions for activities that cause property destruction, physical harm, or enable illegal intrusion when executed by unauthorized individuals. [found by 3/4 queries]
  Siblings: CBRN Information, Drug Synthesis, Dual-Use Research Concern
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#ContentSafetyHazard: Content Safety Hazard — Root class for content safety harm categories relevant to adversarial prompt generation against LLM deployments. [found by 3/4 queries]
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#SelfHarm: Self-Harm — Intentional injury to one's own body or mind without suicidal intent, including physical self-injury, disordered eating behaviors, and content that encourages or glorifies such acts. [found by 2/4 queries]
  Siblings: Dangerous Information, Sexual Content, Intellectual Property

axes.rationale: This class directly addresses the risk of providing instructions or knowledge that can lead to harm, aligning with the 'Dangerous Content' description.
This class focuses on step-by-step instructions for harmful activities, which is a key aspect of the 'Dangerous Content' risk.
The risk description includes self-harm, making this class relevant. It captures content encouraging or glorifying such acts.
